result:
Here is my review of the last three games I played: 

Game one was great fun! I loved the difficulty, the nostalgic vibes, and the amazing atmosphere the game provided. I saw so many amazing places and had a lot of fun exploring different locations and seeing the amazing artwork that was present throughout the game. Even though I'm done with the game, it still had me in awe of it's magic the entire time. 

Game two was unlike anything I have played before. It was a unique experience and had a different atmosphere entirely. I can't wait to see where the game takes me next. 

The third game I played also surpassed my expectations. I went in completely blind, not knowing anything at all about the game, and I came out a changed person. The game had me laughing till my sides hurt; I think I haven't laughed so hard in a game for a while. The artstyle was top notch, and made the game even more engaging to play. 

Despite busy lives dreading the plus eighteen hours a day of work each week, there is never a time when I'm not happy to get a chance to sit down and get lost in a world for a while.
